michael-cao.text: Moved and voted for the FY2026-27 budget (June 16, 2026; passed 4-1, Kwan dissenting).

source.title: Arcadia City Council Regular Meeting Minutes, June 16, 2026

michael-cao.text: Seconded and voted for (June 16, 2026) approving a 30-unit SB 330 condominium project at 514 Fairview Avenue that the Planning Commission had denied.

source.title: Arcadia City Council Regular Meeting Minutes, June 16, 2026

michael-cao.text: Per his official city biography, as 2024-25 mayor he made public safety his top priority and "actively supported Proposition 36"; he serves on the Arcadia Police Foundation board.

source.title: Council Member Michael Cao, M.D. - City of Arcadia

steve-rhee.text: "I'll support policies and plans designed to fight crime, stop external influence, and make our neighborhoods and businesses safer."
"I will support efforts that protect our residents and businesses while addressing crime, homelessness, and the issues affecting the safety and quality of life in our community."
"I'm self-funding my campaign and not accepting financial donations because I want residents to know that when I make a decision, my responsibility is to our community, not donors."

notes: Cao has no campaign site found; his items are council votes and his city biography. Rhee's site gives general positions only (endorsements page 404). An independent committee opposing Cao is registered. Searches used: 12.
